questions.question:
**Given below are four jumbled sentences. Pick the option that gives their correct order.**

A. He decides to leave home and sets out to find him with the help of his best friend called Sungreen.

B. It narrates the story of a young and sensitive boy in a tough world.

C. ‘A Boy and Sungreen’ is a film by the Chinese filmmaker, Ahn-Ju-Young.

D. When he finds that his supposedly dead father is alive he decides to act.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is CBDA.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• While arranging the parts of the passage, we should find some grammatical or contextual connections between them-
 
 
• Of the given options, only Sentence **C **can be the opening statement as it tells us about the film 'A boy and Sungreen'.
 
• The next statement must be **B** as it mentions the plot around which the movie revolves.
 
• Hence it will be the 2nd sentence.
 
• The given formation is followed only in the 2nd option.

 
 
 
 
• Thus, the correct order is- *‘A Boy and Sungreen’ is a film by the Chinese filmmaker, Ahn-Ju-Young. It narrates the story of a young and sensitive boy in a tough world. When he finds that his supposedly dead father is alive he decides to act. He decides to leave home and sets out to find him with the help of his best friend called Sungreen.*

questions.question:
**Select the correct Indirect form of the given sentence.**

The minister said, “It is tragic that the Australian bush fires have claimed the lives of so many helpless animals.”

options.text: The minister said that it was tragic that the Australian bush fires had claimed the lives of so many helpless animals.
The minister said that it was tragic that the Australian bush fires claimed the lives of so many helpless animals.
The minister said that it was tragic that the Australian bush fires were claiming the lives of so many helpless animals.
The minister said that it was tragic that the Australian bush fires have been claiming the lives of so many helpless animals.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **The minister said that it was tragic that the Australian bush fires had claimed the lives of so many helpless animals.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's look at the steps to change the sentence from direct to indirect speech:
 
• When the direct speech is in an assertive form, we follow the steps given below:
 
 
• Convert the sentence in the direct speech into assertive.
 
• The tense of reported speech is changed only when the reporting verb is in the past tense. 
 
• The reporting verb said will remain the same.
 
• The connector 'that' will follow the removal of comma and inverted commas.
 
• The present simple tense i.e. is will be changed to the past simple tense i.e. was.
 
• Similarly, the present perfect tense i.e. have claimed will be changed to the past perfect tense i.e. had claimed.
 
 
 
• ​​At last line up the remaining part.

 

Following these steps, we get- *The minister said that it was tragic that the Australian bush fires had claimed the lives of so many helpless animals.*

questions.question:
**Given below are four jumbled sentences. Pick the option that gives their correct order.**

A. He would be accompanied by fifty or sixty torchbearers.

B. When dawn broke the Emperor would alight, say his prayers and return by 8 a.m.

C. They would all head towards the river Jamuna.

D. During the winter months the Badshah Bahadur Shah Jafar would set off on his horse at 3 a.m.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is DACB.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• While arranging the parts of the passage, we should find some grammatical or contextual connections between them:
 
 
• Sentence D introduces us to the subject '**Badshah Bahadur Shah Jafar**'. It is the introductory sentence and will be put in the first place.
 
• Sentence A tells us about the torchbearers who accompanied the Emperor. It will be put in second place.
 
• Sentence C tells us the direction followed by the above-mentioned group. It will be put in third place.
 
• The last sentence is B as it mentions the concluding activity.

 
 
 

Thus, the correct order is- *During the winter months the Badshah Bahadur Shah Jafar would set off on his horse at 3 a.m. He would be accompanied by fifty or sixty torchbearers. They would all head towards the river Jamuna. When dawn broke the Emperor would alight, say his prayers and return by 8 a.m.*

questions.question:

DETERIORATE
questions.solution:
The correct answer is '**Worsen**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• ​The word Deteriorate(verb) means- "**to become worse**". (बदतर हो जाना) 

 
 
• E.g: *My eyesight began to **deteriorate **quite rapidly.​*
 
 
 
• *​*The synonyms of the given word Deteriorate are- 'Worsen', '**decline**', '**decay**', '**fall**', '**decompose**', etc.
 
• From the synonyms of the given word, we can say that the word 'Worsen' is similar in meaning.
 
• The word Worsen(verb) means- "**to become worse or to make something become worse**". (बदतर होना या कुछ खराब करना)
 
 
• E.g: *The continued supply of arms to the region will only **worsen **the situation.​*
 
 
 
• ​Hence, the correct option is Option 2).
 
• Let's have a look at the meaning of other given options:
 
 
• **Enliven**(verb)- "**to make something more interesting**". (कुछ और दिलचस्प बनाने के लिए)
 
• **Fasten**(verb)- "**to make or become firmly attached or closed**". (मजबूती से जुड़ा या बंद होना या बनना)
 
• **Improve**(verb)- "**to get better, or to make something better**". (बेहतर करने के लिए, या कुछ बेहतर करने के लिए)
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**
